title: MAGIKARP v0.1 — Prospective Failure-Depth Diagnosis Benchmark
description: MAGIKARP v0.1 is a deterministic synthetic research benchmark for testing whether prospective failure-depth diagnosis adds held-out predictive information about later recovery beyond present competence, ordinary error sensitivity, and a frozen standard-adaptation control. The built-in generator is explicitly engineering-only (L0) and does not constitute evidence for the scientific hypothesis, representation invention, Controlled Representational Escape, causal efficacy, or general intelligence. This release freezes the measurement instrument, evidence-governance protocol, validity gates, provenance and attestation machinery, and successor-team handoff at the point before any qualifying L2/L3 evidence source exists.
